lede: The biggest thing on the table this week is the Telluride Hospital District board's discussion and possible action on a Two Site Model — where THD delivers care going forward is a long-term question for this whole valley, and Wednesday's meeting is where that conversation gets formal. Same day, P&Z hears the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment PUD at 860 Black Bear Rd, and Town Council meets Monday for first readings on two ordinances plus a gondola IGA supplement tied to SMART 3A funding. It's a heavy week for anyone paying attention to how this place is shaped.

notable.stake: Board may act on Two Site Model reshaping how THD delivers care.
PUD hearing for Town-owned 860 Black Bear Rd could expand dimensional limits.
Variance vote to reduce setback on Mountain Village parcel near County Road 63L.
Council votes on gondola IGA supplement and two ordinances at first reading.
